description: Create three frozen tagged zombies, then release all after a new goal_exec PlanRun exists.
releaseCommands: execute as @e[type=minecraft:zombie,tag=mineclaw_test] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:0b,Invulnerable:0b}
sampleCommands: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:zombie,tag=mineclaw_test] run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:zombie,tag=mineclaw_test,limit=1,sort=nearest] Pos
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:zombie,tag=mineclaw_test] run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:zombie,tag=mineclaw_test,limit=1,sort=nearest] Health
